run_enumerate_test_targets: run the script to enumerate test targets for a BOP dataset evaluation
run_get_split_params: run get_split_params to load dataset split parameters for a given BOP dataset
run_load_scene_gt: run load_scene_gt to load ground-truth poses for a specific scene from the dataset
run_save_json: run save_json to write the enumerated test targets list to a JSON file
run_load_json: run load_json to load an image subset file specifying which image IDs to use
